label: Broker
mood: Achromatic base, one accent, tinted near-black ink. The measured convention of high-pedigree US brokerages, applied to the existing Leveraged Agent colors.
note: v1 tokens.css remains the shipping palette until Ryan adopts one of these. Both brand colors are unchanged from v1: deep #08343E and gold #E8A33D. The cream base becomes pure white and sage #B5CAC4 is deleted. There is deliberately no accent-2: one accent is the point.

bg.role: primary surface, pure white. Do not tint it

bg-2.role: sunken fill, table rows, inset panels

bg-inv.role: inverted surface, brand deep teal. Plays black's role

line.role: hairline and divider on bg, non-text

structure.role: canonical teal. Chart bars, structural fills, large headings

ink-2.role: secondary text on bg and bg-2

accent.role: THE accent, canonical gold. Fills and buttons, never text on bg

accent-txt.role: accent used AS text on bg or bg-2

accent-inv.role: accent used AS text on bg-inv. Raw gold is legible there
